sleeping_bag.name: X-LITE 200
sleeping_bag.subtitle: extremely light 2 season down sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: The X-LITE 200 is presented as a minimalist, extremely light down sleeping bag focused on maximum warmth-to-weight ratio and very small packed size. Cumulus emphasizes ultralight Toray Airtastic fabric, 900 FP Polish goose down, a slim shape, the anatomical shark-fin footbox, H-shaped chambers and compact warmth for fast-and-light use.
sleeping_bag.key_features:
- 350 g total weight
- 200 g of 900 FP ethically sourced Polish goose down
- Comfort 4 C / limit 0 C / extreme -15 C
- Toray Airtastic 19 g/m2 shell and liner
- 7D ripstop, DWR finish, 100% nylon
- 3 mm YKK 2/3 zip with 2 self-locking sliders and insulated tube
- H-shaped chamber design
- Differential cut
- Stuffsack and storage sack included
- Customizable via configurator
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Cumulus positions the X-Lite series as world-leading in weight-to-warmth ratio, designed to remove every unnecessary gram while keeping real field usability and compressibility.
sleeping_bag.ideal_for: Fast-paced trips, users prioritizing compact gear, trail running, ultramarathons, bikepacking, sport rock climbing.
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: One block positions the product as 2 season while another visible feature block mentions 2-3 season. Current direct pages and indexed product extraction also show different locale-dependent prices and lead times.
sleeping_bag.warranty_notes: Warranty name shown as Lifetime Experience.
